name.es: Concejo de la Villa de Key Biscayne

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Key Biscayne Village Council took from November 17, 2022 to October 13, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 61 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. This list goes back to November 2022, when Vazquez and Sardiñas took office. Twelve meetings from that period have agendas but no posted minutes (January 17, February 15, March 14, September 12 and two on September 26, 2023; June 25, September 10, September 24, October 22 and October 23, 2024), so their votes are not shown; later meetings without minutes are handled the same way. Their 2022 campaign reports, posted as scans on the village's archive page, were read by hand: Sardiñas listed 26 outside gifts ($5,607.11); Vazquez funded his 2022 campaign himself and listed no outside gifts.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto del Concejo de la Villa de Key Biscayne entre el 17 de noviembre de 2022 y el 13 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 61 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. Esta lista se remonta a noviembre de 2022, cuando Vazquez y Sardiñas asumieron el cargo. Doce reuniones de ese periodo tienen agenda pero no actas publicadas (17 de enero, 15 de febrero, 14 de marzo, 12 de septiembre y dos el 26 de septiembre de 2023; 25 de junio, 10 de septiembre, 24 de septiembre, 22 de octubre y 23 de octubre de 2024), así que no se muestran sus votos; las reuniones posteriores sin actas se tratan igual. Sus informes de campaña de 2022, publicados como imágenes escaneadas en la página de archivo de la villa, se leyeron a mano: Sardiñas declaró 26 donaciones de terceros ($5,607.11); Vazquez financió su campaña de 2022 él mismo y no declaró donaciones de terceros.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Konsèy Vilaj Key Biscayne te pran ant 17 novanm 2022 ak 13 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 61 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Lis sa a kòmanse an novanm 2022, lè Vazquez ak Sardiñas te pran pòs yo. Douz reyinyon nan peryòd sa a gen ajanda men pa gen pwosè-vèbal pibliye (17 janvye, 15 fevriye, 14 mas, 12 septanm ak de nan 26 septanm 2023; 25 jen, 10 septanm, 24 septanm, 22 oktòb ak 23 oktòb 2024), kidonk vòt yo pa parèt; reyinyon pita ki pa gen pwosè-vèbal trete menm jan an. Rapò kanpay 2022 yo, ki afiche kòm imaj eskane sou paj achiv vilaj la, te li alamen: Sardiñas te deklare 26 don lòt moun ($5,607.11); Vazquez te finanse kanpay 2022 li li menm epi li pa t deklare okenn don lòt moun.

gaps.issue: Tenure extension (Oct 25, 2026): Vazquez and Sardinas were installed Nov 17, 2022. Granicus posts minutes for 30 of the 41 council meetings from Nov 29, 2022 to Dec 17, 2024 (the Nov 29 and Dec 13, 2022 minutes are scans, read by OCR). No minutes posted for: Jan 17, Feb 15 (regular), Mar 14, Sep 12, Sep 26 (budget and special) 2023; Jun 25, Sep 10, Sep 24, Oct 22, Oct 23 2024. Private-party items from those agendas are listed with roll null.

2022-2024: the 1047 Mariner Drive variance was deferred on Jun 6, 2023 (5-2); its later disposition is not in the posted minutes (the Jul 18, 2023 minutes PDF ends with the resolution title only). The 299 Crandon Boulevard time extensions (Nov 14, 2023) are left out because the property is county library land. Chamber of Commerce, interlocal, grant and union items follow the standard.

Granicus posts minutes for only 12 of the 2025-2026 meetings (2025-01-14 regular and LPA, 2025-02-11, 2025-03-18, 2025-04-08, 2025-05-13 regular and LPA, 2025-06-10, 2025-07-01, 2026-02-10, 2026-04-14, 2026-05-14). Minutes are not included in later agenda packets. Every other council meeting from 2025-08-19 through 2026-10-13, and the 2025-01-28 special meeting, is agenda-only; their private-party agenda items are listed with roll null
Several minutes PDFs are scans with OCR noise; rolls were read from the "voting Yes / voting No" lists and checked by hand for split votes
Councilmember Bracken recused himself on the 12-22-24 Crandon Boulevard site plan; he is marked absent in that roll
Applicants or owners are not named in titles for the variances at 920 Mariner Drive and 640 South Mashta Drive, or for the 101 Harbor Drive rezoning
Workshops (infrastructure, undergrounding, shoreline, swale, budget, Zone 1) take no votes and are not listed

Excluded under the standard: FDEP, FEMA, NOAA, FIND, UASI and county grant and interlocal items, School Board joint use, Supervisor of Elections polling agreement, police union contracts, code amendments and budgets
